frozen_note: written on 2026-10-24 after a format probe of the raw files (column names, null counts, which seasons each source covers, team-total differences) and before building the dataset; no model or outcome metric was computed
question: Add shooting attempts, turnovers, offensive/defensive rebounds, fouls, plus-minus and team possessions to the accepted NBA box scores, and add play-in and playoff games, without changing any row the models already use.

base.reference_dataset: normalized/nba_f6_run71_20261009/data (players.jsonl.gz + games.json, regular season, used by v1.1-v1.5 and the live engine)

sources.team_reference: github/9252ea66.../gamelog_{2022..2026}.parquet (official team box, possessions, pace, game minutes); postseason only for 2025-26
sources.postseason_calendar: api_nba_20261006/games_{2022..2024}.json (API-Sports, stage 3, status Finished): Eastern date, home side and final points for 2022-23..2024-25
sources.integrity: every parquet is checked against its manifest sha256 and size before reading (multimarket.archive_file)

excluded.cup_final: one game a season, not counted in standings
excluded.2021-22 postseason: no source with the game date

rules.accepted_tier: regular season 2021-22..2025-26 and postseason 2025-26: each accepted row is extended only if exactly one distinct full count tuple exists among the raw sources for (game, player, team) whose points/rebounds/assists equal the accepted row; zero or several -> the whole game is quarantined (same policy as multimarket.recover)
rules.single_source_tier: postseason 2022-23..2024-25: rows come from sportsdataverse only (provenance 'sportsdataverse_only'); minutes from MM:SS (second precision, not official sub-second); participated = minutes present; status = the box comment
rules.player_identities: every row: points = 2*FGM + 3PM + FTM, rebounds = OREB + DREB, FGM <= FGA, 3PM <= 3PA <= FGA, FTM <= FTA, all counts non-negative integers; a violation quarantines the game
rules.team_reconciliation: accepted tier: sum over players equals the official team box for points, FGM, FGA, 3PM, 3PA, FTM, FTA, OREB, DREB, PF; official team turnovers must be >= the players' sum (the difference is team turnovers); otherwise quarantine
rules.postseason_join: single-source tier: games of one team pair in a season are ordered play-in first, then by game id (round/series/game number), and paired one to one with the API games of that pair ordered by start time; the pair is used only if the counts match, and each game only if the API home team and both final points equal the box score; otherwise the game is excluded and counted
rules.no_ties: a game with equal final points is quarantined

derived.possessions_estimate: per team: FGA - OREB + TOV_players + 0.44*FTA, with the players' turnover sum so that every tier uses the same definition; possessions (official) and pace only where the team box exists
derived.team_turnovers: official team TOV - players' sum, only where the team box exists

acceptance.non_regression: every output regular-season row must equal its reference row on all reference fields, and every output regular game must be a reference game; any difference aborts without writing
acceptance.regular_loss: regular games lost against the reference by the new checks must be <= 2% of the reference; above that the dataset is written with accepted=false
acceptance.report: coverage.json lists rows and games per season and type, quarantine reasons, excluded postseason games and source hashes

scope: data only: it trains, promotes or publishes nothing; models must filter season_type explicitly
